items.title: AB InBev snatches the Champions League from Heineken after 33 years
items.summary: After more than three decades, Heineken must make way for Stella Artois in the Champions League. For AB InBev, the deal fits into its strategy of linking its biggest brands more closely to global media platforms and sporting events. The brewer is “well on its way,” CEO Michel…

items.title: E-commerce is growing the fastest in Southern and Eastern Europe
items.summary: Total European e-commerce revenue rose by 7% last year, from 842 billion euros to 911 billion euros. Although all regions showed growth, the pace varied. European regulations and competition from international platforms remain major concerns.

items.title: Lidl rolls out Scan & Go in France next
items.summary: Following launches in the Netherlands and Germany, Lidl is now rolling out the Scan & Go feature in its Lidl Plus app in France. Customers can scan their groceries with their smartphones as they shop and then pay at a dedicated checkout. The service will also be introduced as…

items.title: Hovis drivers gear up for strike as union warns of bread “shortages”
items.summary: Unite claims a planned strike by Hovis drivers in south-west England will lead to bread “shortages” in affected areas of the UK. The post Hovis drivers gear up for strike as union warns of bread “shortages” appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Henkell moves production of Slovakia’s Hubert brand to Czechia
items.summary: Henkell Freixenet is moving production of its Hubert J.E. sparkling wine business out of Slovakia to neighbouring Czechia.

items.title: Additional handling fee adds another 2 euros to the cost of e-commerce packages
items.summary: The European Commission wants to set the additional handling fee for small packages from outside the EU at 2 euros. The measure primarily affects packages from Chinese online retailers such as Shein, Temu, and Alibaba.

items.title: Nestlé Russia Pledges To Continue Operations, TASS Says
items.summary: Nestlé's Russia pledges to continue operations in Russia despite the Kremlin's decision to put assets under temporary administration.

items.title: Pieces expands in the Netherlands and Belgium: seven new stores in one year
items.summary: Bestseller subsidiary Pieces is picking up the pace in the Netherlands and Belgium. The Danish fashion brand expanded its store network from four to eleven locations in twelve months and is already planning its next opening in Leuven on September 24.

items.title: Puma reshuffles European management team
items.summary: Puma has reshuffled its European management team. Fokko de Rooij, a Dutch national, will become director for Europe effective October 1, while Daniel Pustina will take over as head of Central Europe effective immediately.

items.title: Nestlé Russia: There has been no “change of ownership”
items.summary: Nestlé insists there has been no "change of ownership" in its Russia business despite the Kremlin's seizure of assets. The post Nestlé Russia: There has been no “change of ownership” appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Lidl Ireland’s Ribeye Steak Wins World Steak Challenge Award
items.summary: Lidl Ireland has received the award for the World’s Best Grass-Fed Ribeye at the World Steak Challenge in the Netherlands.

items.title: Gamma chairs barred: Vincent Sheppard wins plagiarism case
items.summary: Furniture manufacturer Vincent Sheppard has obtained a court order in The Hague prohibiting Intergamma from continuing to sell its Amelie garden chairs and lounge sets in the European Union. According to the judge, the models are virtually identical to Vincent Sheppard’s Kodo…

items.title: Van Eerd appeals conviction: “the Public Prosecutor made a mess of it”
items.summary: The appeal by former Jumbo CEO Frits van Eerd begins with a heated clash between his new attorneys and the Public Prosecutor’s Office. The defense argues that crucial documents are missing and wants to significantly expand the investigation. Van Eerd is thus challenging his…

items.title: Aldi Belgium is making headlines again with art: 24.99 euros for a work by Princess Delphine
items.summary: This isn't the first time Aldi in Belgium has offered an exclusive piece of art at a low price: on Saturday, shoppers can purchase a reproduction of Princess Delphine of Saxe-Coburg.

items.title: Industry Organisations In Hungary Call For Margin Freeze To Be Dropped
items.summary: Several food industry organisations in Hungary are calling for the prompt removal of the country's margin freeze.

items.title: Grocery Sales Rise 5.5% In Ireland, Boosted By Back to School
items.summary: Take-home grocery sales rose by 5.5% in Ireland in the four weeks to 6 September, boosted by the back-to-school period.

items.title: France remains weaker sibling within strong performing Kingfisher group
items.summary: Kingfisher, the parent company of the DIY chains B&Q, Screwfix, Castorama, and Brico Dépôt, has had a strong first half of the year but continues to face challenges in the French market.

items.title: Müller in talks to acquire dairy peer Vogtlandmilch
items.summary: Germany's Unternehmensgruppe Theo Müller has confirmed it is in talks to acquire local dairy peer Vogtlandmilch. The post Müller in talks to acquire dairy peer Vogtlandmilch appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Master of Malt cyber breach exposes customer data
items.summary: UK specialist online drinks retailer and whisky bottler Master of Malt has confirmed that customer data was accessed in a cyber breach.

items.title: Mondelēz brings Biscoff partnership to US with Toblerone truffles
items.summary: The launch comes as the snack giant's collaboration with the cookie brand in Europe and other regions “surpassed even our expectations,” according to an executive.

items.title: ‘Largest Price Offensive In Company History’ – Billa Austria Vs Discounters
items.summary: Grocery retailers Billa and Billa Plus have announced ‘the largest price offensive in the company’s history’ across Austria.

items.title: Alcampo Partners With AECOC To Cut Logistics Emissions By 20%
items.summary: Spain’s Alcampo has joined AECOC’s Lean & Green initiative, planning a 20% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions in five years.

items.title: MOL Group Launches Solar Park And Energy Storage Facility In Hungary
items.summary: Hungarian fuel operator MOL Group has inaugurated its new solar park at its Algyő site, featuring an energy storage system.

items.title: Anora Set To Become Exclusive Swedish Distributor For VSPT Wine Group
items.summary: Anora Group has announced that it is set to become the exclusive importer and distributor for VSPT Wine Group’s full portfolio in Sweden.

items.title: Aldi Belgium revises flyer following complaint from Princess Delphine: “Reproduction is not art”
items.summary: Aldi’s announcement that customers could purchase an “exclusive work” by Princess Delphine of Saxe-Coburg for 24.99 euros at its Belgian stores on Saturday has been updated in the online flyer: it is a reproduction, not a work of art.

items.title: Deliveroo And Frozen-Food Retailer Picard Partner All Across France
items.summary: Frozen-food retailer Picard and Deliveroo have expanded their partnership all over France, delivering products in 30 minutes.

items.title: Carrefour Belgium launches fourth edition of Scanmania: shoppers can win a kilogram of gold
items.summary: Carrefour Belgium is once again running its large-scale “Scanmania” promotional campaign through October 28. That means not only significant discounts and thousands of free products, but also the chance to win a gold bar.

items.title: Britain's Co-op Group Posts Bigger First-Half Loss As Investments Weigh
items.summary: Britain's Co-op Group posted a bigger first-half loss on Wednesday as spending on promotions and store improvements weighed on profitability.

items.title: Asahi, Royal Swinkels and PerfectTed to feature at Just Drinks non-alcoholic conference this week
items.summary: Senior leaders from Asahi, PerfectTed, and Royal Swinkels will speak at Just Drinks' two-day conference this week.

items.title: Lidl GB Rolls Out High-Protein Meat Range With Added Pea Protein
items.summary: Lidl GB has introduced a high-protein meat range that combines meat with pea protein.

items.title: Amy’s Kitchen reshapes “complex” production with site closure
items.summary: Amy’s Kitchen has confirmed plans to close a manufacturing plant in California, as the US food group seeks to simplify a “complex” production network. The post Amy’s Kitchen reshapes “complex” production with site closure appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: New distribution center prepares for further growth at Bol
items.summary: The first pile for the new distribution center for the online retailer Bol in Lelystad will be driven into the ground today. With this location, Ahold Delhaize’s e-commerce platform aims to prepare for further volume growth.

items.title: AI retail battle erupts: Amazon blocks Meta’s AI shopping assistant
items.summary: Amazon is denying Muse, Meta's new AI assistant, access to its online store. The conflict highlights how tech giants are battling for (virtual) shoppers, but it also poses a risk of fragmentation for consumers and merchants alike.

items.title: Controversy at Converse: Nike pulls campaign after backlash over “KKK symbols”
items.summary: The shoe brand Converse, part of sports giant Nike, has pulled an advertising campaign and issued an apology following a wave of criticism. According to critics, the images evoked associations with the Ku Klux Klan and lynching.

items.title: Castel launches energy drink Ferox in four African markets
items.summary: Castel Group has launched an energy drinks brand in Africa through its local subsidiary Boissons du Cameroun.

items.title: Grupo Peñaflor capex to include winery, RTD bottling
items.summary: Argentina’s Grupo Peñaflor is lining up a new winery in Mendoza as part of an investment push that also includes its fledgling RTD business.

items.title: World Cup Viewers Were Constantly Exposed To 'Unhealthy' Food And Drink Branding, Study Finds
items.summary: Viewers of the 2026 FIFA World Cup were presented with over 93,000 visible appearances of brands promoting 'unhealthy' food and drink brands.

items.title: NZ fresh-produce firm Spiers Foods appoints administrators
items.summary: New Zealand fresh-produce supplier Speirs Foods has been placed into voluntary administration led by BDO Wellington. The post NZ fresh-produce firm Spiers Foods appoints administrators appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Sazerac to buy German spirits producer Berentzen
items.summary: The deal with Berentzen Group is expected to broaden both companies’ portfolios, capabilities and reach.

items.title: Amy’s Kitchen to shutter California frozen food plant
items.summary: The pioneering organic foods brand will eliminate approximately 260 jobs as it streamlines its manufacturing network amid category-wide headwinds.

items.title: Naturalia Features Animal Welfare Label On Private-Label Broiler Chicken Line
items.summary: Naturalia, a Casino Group organic brand, has announced the roll-out of the Animal Welfare Label on its line of broiler chickens.

items.title: LEAD Network Membership Hits New Milestone
items.summary: LEAD Network, which promotes gender equality and workplace inclusion, has reached a milestone of 30,000 members as growth continues to accelerate.
